# Template — research log entry

Copy into the **top** of `docs/RESEARCH_LOG.md` (newest first). Delete the
guidance in brackets.

---

## YYYY-MM-DD — [One-line claim, stated as a conclusion, not a topic]

[*Good:* "Blocked ordering gives ~2× smaller MPS bond dimension".
*Bad:* "MPS ordering investigation".]

**What was measured.** [Exact quantity, on what data, with what command or
script. A reader must be able to repeat it.]

```
[command, or the artifact path]
```

**Numbers.** [With units. Include the spread, not just the central value —
"median 0.167, 92% above 0.1" is useful; "high" is not.]

**Interpretation.** [What it means. Separate this from the measurement — the
numbers may outlive the interpretation.]

**What it changes.** [Which decision, invariant, doc, or plan is now different.
If nothing changes, say so; a null result is still worth recording.]

**Caveats.** [Confounds, sample size, anything unverified. If the producing
script does not exist, say so explicitly — see the orphan artifacts in
`DATA_CATALOG.md` §8 for why this matters.]

**Links.** [`OPEN_QUESTIONS.md` Qn · `INVARIANTS.md` In · `DECISIONS.md` Dn]
